ui.title: A World Through Two Senses
ui.subtitle: VINCENT VAN GOGH, REIMAGINED THROUGH MUSIC
ui.statementSecond: I listen to what he felt.
ui.concept: ONE PAINTING. ONE SONG. ONE PERSONAL INTERPRETATION.
ui.dialogueSecond: and music chosen by one listener.
ui.journey: Follow the journey, or find your own way through.
ui.endingQuote: The world does not end where a painting ends.
ui.aboutDescription: This exhibition creates a dialogue between Vincent van Gogh’s paintings and contemporary music personally selected by the curator.
ui.aboutStructure: The five acts explore emotional and philosophical dimensions of human experience, rather than a chronological biography.
ui.conceptSentence: One painting. One song. One personal interpretation.
ui.footerCredit: All artworks by Vincent van Gogh. Public-domain artworks; image sources and reuse details accompany each work.
ui.creditsDescription: All paintings are by Vincent van Gogh. Artwork descriptions are visual summaries, separate from the curator’s personal notes. Dates and collection information are drawn from the linked sources.
ui.description: Twenty paintings by Vincent van Gogh, five intimate acts, and a personally curated soundtrack. One painting. One song. One personal interpretation.
ui.shareImageAlt: Almond Blossom, Vincent van Gogh, 1890. Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam. Public-domain reproduction.

almond.title: Almond Blossom
almond.description: White blossoms reach across a clear turquoise sky. Dark, branching contours give each delicate flower a quiet presence.
almond.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

irises.title: Irises
irises.description: Violet irises rise from a tangle of pointed green leaves. A single pale flower interrupts the rhythm of the crowded garden.
irises.collection: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles
irises.credit: Vincent van Gogh · J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles · Wikimedia Commons

wheatfield.title: A Wheatfield, with Cypresses
wheatfield.description: Golden wheat bends beneath rolling clouds. Dark cypresses stand against the restless curves of the field and sky.
wheatfield.credit: Vincent van Gogh · The National Gallery, London · Wikimedia Commons

sunflowers.title: Sunflowers
sunflowers.description: Ochre, amber and gold fill a simple vase. Flowers at different stages of life turn a familiar still life into a study of luminous yellow.
sunflowers.credit: Vincent van Gogh · The National Gallery, London · Wikimedia Commons

bedroom.title: The Bedroom
bedroom.description: Blue walls meet warm wooden furniture and a red blanket. Tilted lines bring an intimate room close to the viewer.
bedroom.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

yellow-house.title: The Yellow House
yellow-house.description: Sunlit yellow buildings stand beneath a saturated blue sky. Small figures and a distant train bring movement to the street.
yellow-house.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

starry-night.title: The Starry Night
starry-night.description: Stars radiate through a sky of sweeping blue curves. A dark cypress rises above the small, still village below.
starry-night.collection: The Museum of Modern Art, New York
starry-night.credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Museum of Modern Art, New York · Wikimedia Commons

rhone.title: Starry Night over the Rhône
rhone.description: Golden lights stretch across deep blue water. Beneath the stars, two figures stand together at the river’s edge.
rhone.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Musée d’Orsay, Paris · Wikimedia Commons

cafe.title: Café Terrace at Night
cafe.description: A brilliant yellow café spills light onto the cobbled street. Deep blue buildings frame a small opening of star-filled sky.
cafe.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

courting-couples.title: Garden with Courting Couples: Square Saint-Pierre
courting-couples.description: Small figures walk and sit beneath young trees. Short strokes of green and yellow cover the garden and its curving paths.
courting-couples.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

first-steps.title: First Steps, after Millet
first-steps.description: A child stretches toward a kneeling figure across a garden path. Pale greens, blue clothing and flowering trees frame the family.
first-steps.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
first-steps.credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York · Wikimedia Commons

sower.title: The Sower
sower.description: A large yellow sun rises above a blue-violet field. A figure scatters seed across the thickly painted earth.
sower.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

red-vineyard.title: The Red Vineyard
red-vineyard.description: Workers bend among red and orange vines beneath a yellow sky. A bright sun and reflective water mark the distant edge of the field.
red-vineyard.collection: The Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow
red-vineyard.credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow · Wikimedia Commons

mulberry-tree.title: The Mulberry Tree
mulberry-tree.description: Golden leaves spread from a dark, twisting trunk. Curving brushstrokes cross the blue sky and pale ground around the tree.
mulberry-tree.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Norton Simon Museum, Pasadena · Wikimedia Commons

sea-saintes-maries.title: The Sea at Les Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer
sea-saintes-maries.description: Green and blue waves break into white crests in the foreground. Small sails cross the water beneath a pale, clouded sky.
sea-saintes-maries.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

cypress-star.title: Road with Cypress and Star
cypress-star.description: A tall cypress divides a sky lit by a star and crescent moon. Two figures and a carriage travel along the pale winding road.
cypress-star.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

self-portrait.title: Self-Portrait
self-portrait.description: A red beard and attentive gaze stand against swirling blue-green strokes. The cool tones continue through the jacket and background.
self-portrait.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Musée d’Orsay, Paris · Wikimedia Commons

olive-trees.title: Olive Trees with Yellow Sky and Sun
olive-trees.description: Gnarled olive trunks rise from orange and violet earth. A yellow sun shines above the grove and a line of blue mountains.
olive-trees.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Minneapolis Institute of Art, Minneapolis · Wikimedia Commons

thunderclouds.title: Wheatfield under Thunderclouds
thunderclouds.description: An expansive green wheatfield stretches beneath deep blue clouds. Broad horizontal bands carry the landscape toward the horizon.
thunderclouds.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

tree-roots.title: Tree Roots
tree-roots.description: Interlaced roots and tree trunks fill the canvas. Patches of blue, green and ochre trace the exposed earth and tangled growth.
tree-roots.credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

act-1.title: The Courage to Begin
act-1.introduction: Spring, encounters, hope, and love. A beginning can be a quiet act of courage.

act-2.title: The Beautiful Art of Burning
act-2.introduction: Creativity and labour, passion and summer. The intensity of being alive, held in colour.

act-3.title: A Sky Without Borders
act-3.introduction: Sea, night, and stars. An invitation to look beyond the familiar, towards freedom and the vastness of existence.

act-4.title: The Rooms Within Us
act-4.introduction: Private spaces, relationships, and self-perception. A closer look at intimacy and the vulnerability of being seen.

act-5.title: Everything Is Still Becoming
act-5.introduction: Nature, uncertainty, and resilience. Life continues through change, with no final shape and no fixed ending.
